purpose: Store educational materials such as worksheets, games, and resources.

courseId.description: ID of the course this material is linked to.

topicId.description: ID of the topic this material is linked to.

url.description: URL or storage path of the material.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the material was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the material was last updated.

access_patterns.teacher: read/write if linked to their course
access_patterns.parent: read if linked to their child’s course
access_patterns.kid: read if linked to their course

composite_indexes_needed.description: For querying materials by course and topic.

validation_rules: type must be one of the predefined types.
url must be a valid URL.
tags must be an array of strings.
performance_notes: Indexes on courseId and topicId are critical for material queries.
